title: 第26章 寻金鼠
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
郁凡快速朝郁嘉庆所指方向奔驰而去。

    他在城市的高楼大厦顶端飞跃着，如同一只黑色的巨鹰，倒是并未引起他人注意。

    一路上神识不断扫视着，郁凡知道现在社会处处是监控，也是在尽量避开天眼所在之处。

    一个多小时左右，郁凡总算是看到了山区的影子，神识观察一番后，发现周围确实没有其他生物的存在。

    这才放心的在此地开始准备渡劫，将自己一直压制的修为释放开来。

    筑基期的劫是极为简单的，至少对于郁凡来说，这劫雷的威力并不大。

    如手指般粗细的蓝色劫雷打在他身上，竟让他产生一种异常舒适的感觉。

    大概是真的太久没有过这种被雷劈的感觉了。

    郁凡只想感叹一声：“真爽！”

    他目前的身体虽然并不是曾经的钢筋铁骨，但雷劫显然也并不能在他身上留下痕迹。

    郁凡当然不会浪费这次能打造筋骨的劫雷，他直接将准备撤回的蓝雷给扯了回来，吸收进自己的体内。

    劫雷不断在身体内横行，妄图想着逃出去。

    然而威力毕竟不大，只能生生被郁凡吸收殆尽。

    郁凡吸收完劫雷后，好好巩固了一番自己目前的修为，才睁开眼睛。

    看了看四周的状况，还好没有造成什么损失。

    要不是曾经渡劫的时候产生过太大的动静，他也不至于草木皆兵。

    郁凡感叹了一番，正准备离去的时候，却听到了草丛里“窸窸窣窣”的声音。

    利眸瞬间扫了过去，才发现原来是一只老鼠。

    就觉得不太可能，毕竟自己可是仔细观察过，可是确定了没有人的存在的。

    郁凡不在意的看了一眼，便准备离去。

    谁知那小老鼠不知道是受到了什么惊吓，居然一下子从草丛里滚了出来。

    直溜溜的滚到了郁凡的脚下。

    郁凡：......

    看着地上装死的老鼠，他准备直接跨过去的时候，那老鼠突然直接跳了起来。

    朝着他的面部袭击而来。

    郁凡一惊，现在老鼠都这么厉害了？居然能跳这么高？！

    他简直是不敢置信，却快速的避开了老鼠的袭击。

    谁知道，那老鼠紧追不舍，看到没有扑倒郁凡，又转过弯来继续朝郁凡而来。

    郁凡不想和一个老鼠浪费时间，在他看来，这老鼠弱得一笔，一根指头都能捏死了。
content_en:
Yu Fan quickly ran towards the direction pointed by Yu Jiaqing.

He was flying on top of the city's high-rise buildings like a giant black eagle, but he didn't attract anyone's attention.

His spiritual consciousness kept scanning along the way. Yu Fan knew that surveillance was everywhere in society now, and he tried to avoid the place where the Eye of Heaven was.

For more than an hour, Yu Fan finally saw the shadow of the mountainous area. After observing with his spiritual consciousness, he found that there were indeed no other creatures around.

Only then could he feel relieved and start preparing to overcome the tribulation here, releasing the cultivation he had been suppressing.

The calamity in the foundation building stage is extremely simple. At least for Yu Fan, the power of this calamity thunder is not great.

The blue thunderbolt as thick as a finger struck him, making him feel extremely comfortable.

It's probably been a long time since I've had this feeling of being struck by lightning.

Yu Fan just wanted to sigh: "It's so cool!"

Although his current body is not the steel frame it once was, it is obvious that the thunder calamity cannot leave any traces on him.

Of course, Yu Fan would not waste this calamity thunder that could build muscles and bones. He directly pulled back the blue thunder that was about to withdraw and absorbed it into his body.

The calamity thunder kept running rampant in the body, trying desperately to escape.

However, the power is not great after all, and it can only be absorbed by Yu Fan.

After Yu Fan absorbed the tribulation thunder, he consolidated his current cultivation before opening his eyes.

After looking at the surrounding situation, fortunately, no damage was caused.

If there hadn't been too much noise during the tribulation, he wouldn't have been completely defeated.

Yu Fan sighed and was about to leave when he heard a "rustling" sound in the grass.

His sharp eyes glanced over in an instant, only to realize that it was a mouse.

I thought it was impossible. After all, I had carefully observed it and confirmed that no one existed.

Yu Fan glanced at it casually and prepared to leave.

Unexpectedly, the little mouse suddenly rolled out of the grass because of some fright.

He rolled straight to Yu Fan's feet.

Yu Fan:......

Looking at the mouse pretending to be dead on the ground, when he was about to step over it, the mouse suddenly jumped up.

Attacked towards his face.

Yu Fan was shocked, are rats so powerful now?Can he jump so high?!

He couldn't believe it, but he quickly avoided the rat's attack.

Who would have known that the mouse was chasing after Yu Fan, and when he saw that Yu Fan was not knocked down, he turned around and continued to come towards Yu Fan.

Yu Fan didn't want to waste time with a mouse. In his opinion, this mouse was so weak that it could be crushed to death with one finger.
